correctness.rationale: Under a fixed rank permutation pi and inter-block weak order, the first two blocks of eight terms supply five consecutive Van der Laan four-window equalities E_s=0 and fifteen weak-rank, block-order and nonnegativity inequalities I_j<=0. The exact 23 certificate rows in certificates.json express x0+x1+x2+x3 as sum of nonnegative multiples of I_j plus rational multiples of E_s, for every nonidentity pi. A fresh independent BigInt rational-linear-form evaluator reconstructed every E_s/I_j from the permutations, checked unique coverage of all 23 nonidentity permutations, nonnegative inequality multipliers and all 23 coefficientwise identities with zero errors; hence the first block must be zero and the four-window condition propagates all subsequent terms to zero. For identity pi the hypotheses mean global monotonicity and force a_{n+3}=a_n+a_{n+1}, equivalently a_n=a_{n-2}+a_{n-3} for n>=4, with exactly 0<=u<=v<=w<=u+v; elementary induction preserves monotonicity. This certifies ALL infinite sequences with the stated fixed 4-block restriction, not merely sampled initial terms.
